targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.address_canonical
targets.header:
theorem address_canonical (d : RotationAddress) :
    (address d).num = (d.p : ℤ) ∧ (address d).den = d.q

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.address_interval
targets.header: theorem address_interval (d : RotationAddress) : 0 < address d ∧ address d < 1

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.address_injective
targets.header: theorem address_injective (d e : RotationAddress) (h : address d = address e) : d = e

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.address_surjective
targets.header:
theorem address_surjective (x : ℚ) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    ∃ d : RotationAddress, address d = x

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.q_at_least_two
targets.header: theorem q_at_least_two (d : RotationAddress) : 2 ≤ d.q

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.modulus_pos
targets.header: theorem modulus_pos (d : RotationAddress) : 0 < modulus d

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.word_sum
targets.header:
theorem word_sum (d : RotationAddress) (u : Fin d.q) :
    wordValue d u = ∑ i : Fin d.q, digit d u i * 2 ^ (d.q - 1 - i.val)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.upper_digit_equiv
targets.header:
theorem upper_digit_equiv (d : RotationAddress) (i : Fin d.q) :
    upperDigit d i = if d.q - d.p ≤ ((i.val + 1) * d.p) % d.q then 1 else 0

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.lower_digit_equiv
targets.header:
theorem lower_digit_equiv (d : RotationAddress) (i : Fin d.q) :
    1 ≤ (i.val + 1) * d.p ∧
      lowerDigit d i = if d.q - d.p ≤ ((i.val + 1) * d.p - 1) % d.q then 1 else 0

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.word_bounds
targets.header:
theorem word_bounds (d : RotationAddress) (u : Fin d.q) :
    0 < wordValue d u ∧ wordValue d u < modulus d

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.characteristic_bounds
targets.header:
theorem characteristic_bounds (d : RotationAddress) :
    0 < lowerNumerator d ∧ lowerNumerator d < upperNumerator d ∧ upperNumerator d < modulus d

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.characteristic_adjacent
targets.header: theorem characteristic_adjacent (d : RotationAddress) : upperNumerator d = lowerNumerator d + 1

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.characteristic_angle_gap
targets.header:
theorem characteristic_angle_gap (d : RotationAddress) :
    upperAngle d - lowerAngle d = 1 / (modulus d : ℚ)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.characteristic_period_return
targets.header:
theorem characteristic_period_return (d : RotationAddress) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n = lowerNumerator d ∨ n = upperNumerator d) : iterateNum d n d.q = n

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.characteristic_period_minimal
targets.header:
theorem characteristic_period_minimal (d : RotationAddress) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n = lowerNumerator d ∨ n = upperNumerator d)
    (k : ℕ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkq : k < d.q) : iterateNum d n k ≠ n

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.same_cycle
targets.header:
theorem same_cycle (d : RotationAddress) :
    ∃ i : Fin d.q, orbitPoint d i.val = lowerNumerator d

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.word_strict
targets.header: theorem word_strict (d : RotationAddress) : StrictMono (wordValue d)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.orbit_set_eq
targets.header:
theorem orbit_set_eq (d : RotationAddress) :
    orbitSet d = Finset.univ.image (wordValue d)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.orbit_card
targets.header: theorem orbit_card (d : RotationAddress) : (orbitSet d).card = d.q

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.orbit_length
targets.header: theorem orbit_length (d : RotationAddress) : (orderedOrbit d).length = d.q

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.rank_word
targets.header: theorem rank_word (d : RotationAddress) (u : Fin d.q) : rank d (wordValue d u) = u.val

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.double_word
targets.header:
theorem double_word (d : RotationAddress) (u : Fin d.q) :
    doubleNum d (wordValue d u) =
      wordValue d ⟨(u.val + d.p) % d.q, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_trans d.p_pos d.p_lt_q)⟩

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.rank_step
targets.header:
theorem rank_step (d : RotationAddress) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ orbitSet d) :
    rank d (doubleNum d x) = (rank d x + d.p) % d.q

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.unique_unit_gap
targets.header:
theorem unique_unit_gap (d : RotationAddress) :
    ∃ i : Fin (orderedOrbit d).length,
      edgeStart d i = lowerNumerator d ∧ edgeEnd d i = upperNumerator d ∧
        directedGap d i = 1 ∧
          ∀ j : Fin (orderedOrbit d).length, j ≠ i → 2 ≤ directedGap d j

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.angle_order
targets.header:
theorem angle_order (d e : RotationAddress) (h : address d < address e) :
    upperAngle d < lowerAngle e

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.intervals_disjoint
targets.header:
theorem intervals_disjoint (d e : RotationAddress) (h : address d < address e) :
    Disjoint (angleInterval d) (angleInterval e)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.mediant_interval
targets.header:
theorem mediant_interval (d e : RotationAddress)
    (h : address d < address e)
    (hadj : FVLT.FareyContactV1.fareyAdj (address d) (address e)) :
    ∃ m : RotationAddress,
      address m = FVLT.FareyContactV1.mediant (address d) (address e) ∧
        upperAngle d < lowerAngle m ∧ upperAngle m < lowerAngle e

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.farey_denominator_min
targets.header:
theorem farey_denominator_min (x y z : ℚ) (hxy : x < y)
    (hadj : FVLT.FareyContactV1.fareyAdj x y) (hxz : x < z) (hzy : z < y) :
    x.den + y.den ≤ z.den

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.farey_denominator_eq_iff
targets.header:
theorem farey_denominator_eq_iff (x y z : ℚ) (hxy : x < y)
    (hadj : FVLT.FareyContactV1.fareyAdj x y) (hxz : x < z) (hzy : z < y) :
    z.den = x.den + y.den ↔ z = FVLT.FareyContactV1.mediant x y

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.parameter_fixed_point
targets.header:
theorem parameter_fixed_point (lambda : ℂ) :
    quadratic (cardioidParameter lambda) (alpha lambda) = alpha lambda

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.parameter_multiplier
targets.header: theorem parameter_multiplier (lambda : ℂ) : quadraticMultiplier (alpha lambda) = lambda

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.parameter_derivative
targets.header:
theorem parameter_derivative (lambda : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => quadratic (cardioidParameter lambda) z) lambda (alpha lambda)

targets.name: FVLT.FordBulbV1.canonical_multiplier_primitive
targets.header:
theorem canonical_multiplier_primitive (d : RotationAddress) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (canonicalMultiplier d) d.q
